text.text_excerpt: Love this place! The employees are phenomenal and so nice. Pop in on a nice day for some wine in the sun and if you're hungry, you can even bring over food from next door at 1000 Figs. We went for a flight of wines for $15 and completely enjoyed sipping each and chatting with the lovely customers. I can't believe I only recently discovered this place! P.S. free tastings on Friday evenings!

Stumbled upon this place by accident, and so glad that I did! Located right next to 1000 Figs, we decided to grab a glass of wine while we waited for a table. Loved the atmosphere. It's focus and dedication is WINE, first and foremost...which is special. Good wine is the priority, even more so than room to stand and chat. Nonetheless, we enjoyed both (good wine and good conversation). We tried the special for the night, a lighter red wine for $8. We were in and out pretty quickly, but it was perfect for what we intended. I hope to be back!

Swirl is a great place to stop by if you want a glass (or bottle) to sip on in the store or are looking for a bottle to take home. The staff is super friendly and knowledgable, so can help you out if you have any questions or want a recommendation. There are fun tasting events pretty often, including free tastings of 4-5 wines every Friday that all have a common theme (ex. all French wines) and you learn a cool little bit about each wine that's interesting but not overwhelming. They organize the store by notes of each wine rather than region if you're looking for a big & bold or fresh & fruity, you can check out their curated selections.
